card.line: Galatia was a region in central Asia Minor where Paul visited and strengthened churches, and to which he later wrote a letter about the true gospel.

moments.title: Paul Travels Through Galatia
moments.text: After the Holy Spirit kept them from speaking the word in Asia, Paul and his companions traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.

moments.title: Strengthening the Disciples
moments.text: After some time in Antioch, Paul went from place to place through Galatia and Phrygia. He strengthened all the disciples there.

moments.title: The Collection for the Saints
moments.text: Paul told the Corinthians to set aside money each week for the saints, just as he had directed the churches of Galatia.

moments.title: A Letter to the Churches
moments.text: Paul wrote to the churches of Galatia. He was amazed that they were turning to a different gospel, and he warned them against it.

moments.title: Crescens Goes to Galatia
moments.text: Near the end of his life, Paul wrote that Crescens had gone to Galatia.
